gloss: wrong prediction; unexpected outcome; contrary to expectations

definitions.gloss: wrong prediction; unexpected outcome; contrary to expectations
definitions.explanation: When the actual result differs from what was predicted or expected. Can describe a pleasant or unpleasant surprise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予想違|よそうちが}いだった。
examples.english: The result was contrary to expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{予想違|よそうちが}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧になった。
examples.english: The weather turned out differently than expected and it rained.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{予想違|よそうちが}いで、⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勝|たいしょう}→大勝：31858_taishou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The election results were unexpected for many people, with the opposition winning a landslide.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ (prediction, expectation) and ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (difference, mistake). Part of a family of ～⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ compounds that express something being different from what was intended or expected.
